title: New Congresswoman Who Just Voted Against Jeffries Talks Speaker Role and Rebuilding Trust With Voters
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Hakeem Jeffries is on track to become the first Black House speaker in U.S.
history on Jan. 3, 2027, after Democrats voted overwhelmingly to nominate him
to the position Wednesday.

But [11 Democrats](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-11-dems-vote-against-hakeem-
jeffries) didn't vote for Jeffries, including Rep.-elect **Darializa Avila
Chevalier** , who told **Mehdi** ahead of the vote that "**the speakership, as
a role, has been fully captured by corporate interests**."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

"**Every single person in the Democratic caucus understands that we might have
won the votes, but we didn 't win the trust,**" she said. "**If we are serious
about reestablishing trust with the American people, that has to materialize
in concrete actions from party leadership, from the people who received a
mandate**."

Avila Chevalier also discussed whether she wants her friend Rep. Alexandria
Ocasio-Cortez to run for president, why trying to impeach Trump "**might be
playing into his hand** ," and how central the genocide in Gaza will be in her
work on Capitol Hill.

"**Even now, we 're seeing Israel still bombing hospitals**," she said. "**It
is more imperative than ever that we continue to push to block any arms going
to Israel**."
